arrival.title: YOU HAVE REACHED PRODUCTION
arrival.sub: It is smaller than the slides implied. It is real, which none of the slides were.
arrival.retroNotice: The retrospective begins immediately. Attendance is mandatory. This is the retrospective.

onTime.heading: ARRIVAL: ON TIME
lines: It is before Day 120. The thing arrived while the date still meant something.
Nobody is sure how to behave at a launch that happens on schedule. There is no slide. Someone offers to make one and is gently escorted outside.
The users were not warned, because nobody believed it either.

compliance.heading: ARRIVAL: A COMPLIANCE VICTORY
lines: Every compliance deadline was met. The business deadline was not.
Leadership has reviewed the numbers and declared victory. The attestations are immaculate. The audit trail is a work of art. The thing the users needed arrived after they stopped needing it.
There is a slide. The slide is green. Nothing on the slide is green.

loops.intro: Your journey is scored across the three loops: the agentic loop, the developer loop, and the external loop. The game is saying so plainly, once, because the joke is over and the lesson is not.

agentic.title: 1. THE AGENTIC CODING LOOP
agentic.sub: The loop the agent runs: act, observe, verify, stop. Scored on your best loop, your verifier, and the miles that traveled while you slept.

developer.title: 2. THE DEVELOPER FEEDBACK LOOP
developer.sub: The loop you run around the agent: what you packed, what you hunted, how often you steered instead of rebuilt.

external.title: 3. THE EXTERNAL FEEDBACK LOOP
external.sub: The loop nobody scheduled: whether the thing you shipped was the thing anyone wanted. Measured, for the first time, by asking.

panel.intro: A panel of users has been assembled to evaluate the delivery. They were not consulted during the journey. They were not consulted about the panel. This is the first time anyone has asked them anything, and it shows in how ready they are.

users.name: MIRA, ACCOUNTS
users.good: "It does the thing before the month closes now. I have stopped keeping the spreadsheet that checked your system. I would like those four hours back retroactively, but I will settle for the future ones."
users.bad: "It arrived after we built the workaround, so now we maintain both. The workaround is faster. Please do not tell it I said that. It gets reported on."

users.name: SAL, NIGHT OPERATIONS
users.good: "Nothing paged me during the cutover. I want to be clear about how rare that is. I have seen cutovers. I have a jacket."
users.bad: "The morale on the delivery team was visible from my desk, and my desk is in another building. You can ship a system in that condition. You cannot ship it twice."

users.name: DEE, THE ORIGINAL TICKET
users.good: "This is what I asked for. I filed it so long ago I had to check. It is item one on my list, and someone finally read the list instead of the roadmap."
users.bad: "It is very impressive and it is not what I asked for. What I asked for was smaller. It usually is. Nobody believes us about that."

slides.heading: SLIDE 1 — EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
slides.body: A party departed. A party, in the statistical sense, arrived. Learnings were captured. The capture of learnings is itself a learning. See appendix.

slides.heading: SLIDE 2 — KEY STAKEHOLDERS
slides.body: You. The oxen, which were agents. The agents, which were loops. Boring, who counted. Brilliant, who ran ahead. The Standards Body, which will respond within 45 business days to this slide.

slides.heading: SLIDE 3 — METHODOLOGY
slides.body: Dying, repeatedly, with notes. The notes are in the Field Journal. The dying is in the graveyard feed, where it is helping strangers.

slides.heading: SLIDE 4 — RISKS AND MITIGATIONS
slides.body: Risk: the loop runs without a verifier. Mitigation: it no longer does. Risk: the person becomes the bottleneck. Mitigation: the person read slide 4.

slides.heading: SLIDE 5 — NEXT STEPS
slides.body: There is no slide 5. Go ship something. The deck ends the way decks never do: on purpose.
